steps.text: 1. The actor opens the "Sign in" page (without an account, chooses "Sign up"). A1.

exceptions.text: E6. Weak password → "Password must have at least 8 characters" / "Password must contain both letters and digits".
E7. Email already has an account → "The account is already registered" (409).
E8. Wrong OTP → "Invalid OTP, please try again".
E9. OTP expired → "The verification session has expired, please start again" (410).

steps.text: 2. The system shows a form with Email, Password and a "Forgot password" link. A2.
3. The actor enters the email and password and taps "Sign in". E1.

exceptions.text: E1. Empty field → "Please enter your email" / "Please enter your password".

steps.text: 4. The system sends the sign-in request with the device identifier (deviceId).
5. The system (Auth) normalises the email, checks the account status and matches the password (bcrypt). E2, E3, E4.

exceptions.text: E2. Wrong email or password → "Incorrect email or password"; after 5 failures in a row, sign-in for the account is locked for 15 minutes (423).
E3. The account is banned → "The account has been locked, please contact the Admin".
E4. Account temporarily suspended (suspended, UC#21) → "The account is suspended until <time date>".

steps.text: 6. The system creates a sign-in session for the device and returns the access token and refresh token; for a new device it sends a sign-in alert (UC#23).
7. The system redirects: to the page in the ?next= parameter if present; otherwise Contributor → Studio, Tourist and Admin → home page.

steps: A1.1. The Actor chooses "Sign up" and picks the account type (Tourist / Contributor).
A1.2. The system shows the form: Full name, Email, Password, Confirm password.
A1.3. The actor enters the information and taps "Continue". E5, E6.
A1.4. The system checks the email is not registered yet, stores the sign-up data temporarily (Redis) and sends a 6-digit OTP code by email. E7.
A1.5. The actor enters the OTP code. A3.
A1.6. The system verifies the OTP, creates the account, signs the user in and redirects by role. E8, E9.
A2.1. The actor chooses "Forgot password" and enters the email.
A2.2. The system always returns the same message (it does not reveal whether the email exists); if the account exists, it sends an OTP code by email.
A2.3. The Actor enters the OTP and a new password. A3, E6.
A2.4. The system verifies the OTP, changes the password and signs out every signed-in device; the Actor signs in again with the new password. E8, E9.
A3.1. The actor taps "Resend OTP" (enabled only after 30 seconds).
A3.2. The system sends a new code (the old code stops working) and extends the validity by another 120 seconds.

A4. The access token expires during use: the client refreshes the session with the refresh token (the token is rotated) and resends the request; if the refresh fails, it goes back to the Sign in page.
A5. Change the password while signed in: Account → "Change password", enter the current password and the new password (at least 8 characters, letters and digits, different from the old one).
A6. Sign out: the system revokes the current device's session and deletes the tokens on the device.
